ceo_directive: Complete reproducible flow-loop simulation and define exact physical tests to move TECHNICAL/SAFETY gates to PROVEN.

physical_tests.name: Dual-lumen flow independence
physical_tests.purpose: Verify CSF drainage and drug delivery operate without cross-contamination
physical_tests.target: < 1% drug in drainage lumen at steady state
physical_tests.method: Flow loop with fluorescent drug surrogate; measure fluorescence in drainage outflow

physical_tests.name: Pressure-limiting valve response
physical_tests.purpose: Verify valve prevents drug backflow at differential pressures
physical_tests.method: Progressive pressure ramp; measure drug backflow via fluorescence

physical_tests.name: Drug delivery rate control
physical_tests.purpose: Verify sustained drug delivery at therapeutic rate
physical_tests.target: 0.1-1.0 mL/hr (therapeutic range for CSF drug delivery)
physical_tests.method: Infusion pump + drug surrogate; measure delivery rate over 24h

physical_tests.name: Membrane/coating integrity
physical_tests.purpose: Verify drug-lumen coating does not delaminate under flow
physical_tests.target: No visible delamination; <5% drug burst release
physical_tests.method: 72h flow test; visual inspection + drug release measurement

physical_tests.name: Fail-safe: drainage preservation on drug-lumen failure
physical_tests.purpose: Verify CSF drainage continues when drug lumen occludes
physical_tests.target: ≥0.30 mL/min (≥85% baseline) after drug lumen occlusion
physical_tests.method: Occlude drug lumen; measure drainage flow continuously

gate_progression.TECHNICAL_GATE: 60 → PROVEN if ET1+ET3 pass (flow independence + delivery rate)
gate_progression.SAFETY_GATE: 58 → PROVEN if ET2+ET4+ET5 pass (valve + coating + fail-safe)

note: Engineering is now the bottleneck. Patent result is no longer the dominant problem.
